Definition: Does the register manage income tax, business taxes or both?
redteam_note: Scored 0/Unknown with no source — confirm it is truly unknown, not just unresearched. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Row was scored Unknown with no source; the official NIU (Numero d'Identification Unique) portal and the Ministry of Finance confirm the taxpayer register is compulsory for 'any natural and legal person' carrying out an activity in Congo, i.e. it covers both individual/income taxpayers and business/corporate taxpayers under a single system, administered by the Direction Generale des Impots et des Domaines. This supports a score of 'Both' rather than Unknown.
revised_comments: Congo's unique taxpayer identification number (NIU), administered by the Direction Generale des Impots et des Domaines, is compulsory for both natural persons and legal entities, meaning the digital tax register covers individual/income taxpayers and business/corporate taxpayers under a single scheme. A biometric upgrade (fingerprints, iris scan and QR code) was rolled out from August 2020.
